Mr. A.K. Dhupar, Adv. f  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER  % 17.01.2023  W.P.(CRL) 2682/2022 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 379/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Aman Vihar on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide settlement agreement dated 31st August, 2022 which is on record of this Court.
The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court and are duly identified by their respective counsels and the Investigating Officer.
The other petitioners have been exempted from appearance by a previous order of this Court.

As per the settlement, an amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is to paid at this stage which is being tendered vide DD No.383289 dated 16th January, 2023 drawn on Punjab National Bank to the respondent No.2 who has duly acknowledged and received it in Court.
However, there seems to be a revalidation of the date of the demand draft.
In this event, if the demand draft is not honoured for any reason, the respondent No.2 will be at liberty to approach this Court.

2. However, since the parties are all present in Court and have been on previous dates and the matter stand settled between the parties, the FIR is being quashed, subject to encashment of the said demand draft.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceedings of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.
Consequently, the FIR No. 379/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Aman Vihar and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
4. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
